name: Glossary Tooltip
author: Jumedeen khan

sections.description:
Glossary Tooltip is a lightweight yet powerful plugin that automatically highlights glossary terms in your content and displays tooltips when users hover over them.

It helps improve internal linking, user engagement, and SEO while providing a better reading experience for your visitors.

You can create a dedicated glossary index page, organize terms by categories, customize highlighting behavior, and control how tooltips appear across your website.

The plugin is optimized for performance and uses minimal JavaScript to ensure fast loading and compatibility with caching plugins.

Glossary ToolTip – Features & Advantages

  • Automatically highlight glossary terms in posts and pages
  • Show tooltips when hovering over glossary links
  • Create a dedicated glossary index page
  • Alphabetical glossary navigation (A–Z)
  • Live glossary search on index page
  • Glossary categories support
  • Customize tooltip colors and width
  • Control highlighting behavior (once, multiple times, etc.)
  • Case-sensitive or case-insensitive matching
  • Exclude terms from site search results
  • Ignore headings, links, or specific HTML tags while parsing
  • Mobile tooltip behavior control
  • Content parsing priority control
  • Performance optimization options
  • Optional content caching for faster rendering

Glossary Settings

The plugin provides several flexible configuration options.

General Settings

  • Select which post types should highlight glossary terms
  • Control repeated highlighting behavior
  • Custom glossary permalink slug
  • Custom taxonomy slug for glossary categories
  • Limit highlighting to single posts/pages
  • Exclude glossary terms from site search
  • Enable case-sensitive term matching

Performance & Optimization

  • Parse content only when glossary terms exist
  • Ignore headings (H1–H6) during parsing
  • Ignore links to prevent conflicts
  • Exclude specific HTML tags from parsing
  • Set content parsing priority
  • Limit highlighting to main WP query only
  • Enable parsed content caching
  • Load CSS & JS inline for better performance

Glossary Index Page

  • Choose a page to display the glossary index
  • Alphabetical navigation (A–Z letters)
  • Optional live search filtering
  • Option to disable tooltips on glossary index page
  • Customize typography for glossary index

Glossary Terms Settings

  • Add custom label before glossary term title
  • Add a back link to glossary index page
  • Automatically add title attribute to glossary links
  • Open glossary links in a new tab
  • Control glossary link styling and underline behavior

Tooltip Settings

  • Enable or disable tooltip display
  • Control tooltip excerpt length
  • Mobile tooltip behavior settings
  • Disable tooltips on small screens
  • Custom tooltip width
  • Tooltip text color
  • Tooltip background color
  • Tooltip border color

How It Works

  1. Create glossary terms from Glossary → Add New.
  2. Write the definition or description of the term.
  3. Publish the term.
  4. The plugin automatically highlights that term across your content.
  5. When users hover the highlighted word, a tooltip appears.

You can also create a glossary index page to display all terms alphabetically.

Shortcode

Display the glossary list anywhere using:

[glossary_list]
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for Glossary Tooltip.
  3. Click Install Now and activate the plugin.
  4. Go to Glossary → Settings and configure the options.

Then start adding glossary terms.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin automatically link glossary terms?

Yes. Once a term is created, the plugin automatically highlights and links it in your content.

Can I create a glossary index page?

Yes. You can select a page from the settings or use the shortcode [glossary_list].

Can I control how many times a term is highlighted?

Yes. You can highlight terms once, multiple times, or all occurrences.

Can I disable glossary highlighting on a specific post or page?

Yes. You can disable automatic glossary highlighting for individual posts or pages.

When editing a post or page, look for the Glossary Highlight option in the sidebar and enable Disable glossary highlighting on this post.

Once enabled, glossary terms will not be highlighted in that specific content while the feature remains active for the rest of your site.

Does the plugin support multiple languages?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with multilingual websites.

It uses Unicode-aware parsing, allowing glossary terms to work correctly in languages such as English, Hindi, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, and many others.

The plugin is also translation-ready and works with multilingual plugins like WPML, Polylang, and other translation tools.

Is the plugin performance friendly?

Yes. It includes parsing optimization, caching support, and minimal JavaScript usage.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. Glossary Tooltip works well with popular caching plugins.

Does the plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is designed with performance in mind and uses a lightweight parsing engine to highlight glossary terms efficiently.

It includes smart optimizations such as quick content scanning and optional caching to reduce processing time. This ensures glossary highlighting runs only when necessary and does not impact your website speed.

The plugin also avoids processing inside code blocks, scripts, links, and other HTML elements to keep parsing fast and safe.

Is the documentation available?

Yes. Detailed documentation, setup instructions, and usage examples are available on the official website.

Visit the documentation here: glossarytooltip.com
